title: Chapter 1407
text:
A few days later, in the territory of the Black Star Corps.

Five figures floated above a desolate planet, and four of them stared at one of the figures in a black robe.

"Black Star, you're not joking, right? You want us to help you break through to a higher level?"

Kasuyi was surprised.

"Do I look like I'm joking?"

Han Xiao asked.

After returning from the Arthur Civilization, he immediately contacted the four peak Beyond Grade As and invited them to help him cultivate. Wuornos had agreed long ago, representing the Esper class. The other three classes were Kasuyi, the old dragon, and Sierron, who he did not have a deep relationship with.

The Pugilist class was relatively weak at the higher levels, and there were no powerful figures. Putting aside the revivors, Sierron was already one of the rare cards. Although Han Xiao preferred Carrott at his peak, he had not grown up yet, so there was no need to wait for him. He could just find Sierron.

In the past, during the rescue battle for Hella, he had some conflicts with Sierron. However, after experiencing all kinds of storms together with the association, their relationship had basically returned to normal. This guy was not a direct descendant and had always been on the association's side. Now that he was another vice president, he could still be trusted.

"You're always able to do something unexpected."

The three of them shook their heads helplessly.

When they received Han Xiao's invitation a few days ago, they were all equally shocked. They did not expect Black Star to silently break through to a higher level and open up the path of individual strength.

At first, they thought that Black Star was joking with them, but after confirming it again and again, they realized that Black Star was serious.

Because they had a good relationship with each other, although the three of them were surprised, they still agreed to the invitation and prepared to come and help. What surprised them was the advancement method Black Star had adopted.

"Speaking of which, how can we help you? Shouldn't this kind of thing be done alone? "Milizaus was both curious and confused.

In his impression, breaking through to a higher level and advancing to a higher level of life was something that could only be passed by oneself. Since when did one need help?

"Of course, I have my reasons for doing so." Han Xiao did not explain the principle, and it was not easy to explain.

Wuornos pondered.

"The five of us have different Super systems. Could it be that your idea is to combine the five systems into one …"

Han Xiao interrupted him and waved his hand.

"Why are you asking so many questions now? Since you're already here, just follow the plan and wait for the final result."

Hearing this, Wuornos stopped talking, but he kept thinking in his heart, secretly surprised by Han Xiao's performance.

He was very confused. The method to break through to a higher level should be a mystery to anyone, and Black Star did not look like he had tried it many times, so why did this guy seem so confident? What was the reason behind his train of thought? He had borrowed the Ethereal Nation Treasure and asked a few people for help …

Furthermore, advancement should be risky. Why did Black Star use such a daring method? Was he not afraid? Could it be that he did not realize the dangers of advancement?

All sorts of thoughts flashed through Wuornos' mind. In the end, he shook his head gently, not intending to remind Han Xiao.

In any case, this was Black Star's advancement. He looked very confident, so there was no need for him to kindly remind him. He would just wait and see. Even if he failed, he would be able to broaden his horizons. It was not a loss anyway.

Thinking of this, Wuornos pressed his palm against his chest, and it actually went through. He took out a ball of gentle white light and threw it to Han Xiao.

"This is what you want. I'll lend it to you."

Han Xiao took it and looked down at the Ethereal Nation Treasure. It was different from what he had expected. It seemed to be just a ball of light.

With the real thing beside him, it was not convenient to study it carefully. Han Xiao pressed the Ethereal Nation Treasure to his chest, and the ball of white light quickly merged into his body. A special force immediately surged out and enveloped his entire body. He felt that his cells that were in a critical state immediately calmed down.

Han Xiao glanced at the interface. The first advancement condition had already turned golden and was in the 'triggered' state.

"Then I'll begin."

Han Xiao nodded at everyone before floating a distance away and landing on the surface of the planet.

Seeing his figure shrink into a black dot, Sierron turned to look at the people around him and asked,

"Do you think he'll succeed?"

"If it were that easy, I would have stepped into a higher level long ago."

Wuornos shook his head gently. His tone was calm and disapproving.

Buzz!

At this moment, in everyone's perception, space suddenly shook, and a shocking energy fluctuation burst out with the planet as the center!

In just an instant, a huge gap appeared on the entire planet. The soft liquid in the core gushed out and scattered into the galaxy. Then, the light shrank and expanded like it was breathing, and the next moment, the planet exploded!

Bang!

Amidst the flying fragments and light, Han Xiao's voice did not move. He continuously released shocking energy fluctuations, and his aura rose crazily.

"It's beginning!"

The eyes of the four of them focused, and they immediately released their respective energy according to the plan. They passed through the flying fragments of the planet and entered Han Xiao's body.

Han Xiao bathed in the Radiance that filled the sky. The cells in his body began to go berserk and undergo drastic changes, making him feel as if his body would be separated and reorganized at any time.

However, the Ethereal Nation Weapon floating in his chest released waves at a fixed frequency time and time again, sweeping through his body, allowing his body to begin the transition and sublimation of his cells while maintaining the original structure.

On the other hand, the energy of the four helpers that contained different systems entered his body. They should have been repelled, but at this moment, they were not rejected. Instead, they seemed to be absorbed and quickly fused into his cells.

At the same time, the Beyonder's Vestige that had been silent for many days suddenly shone brightly and burned fiercely, releasing all its energy. It immediately pushed the speed of his advancement and soared.

The feeling of pain and excitement assaulted Han Xiao's mind again and again. He controlled his gaze with difficulty and turned to look at the interface, only to see notifications flooding the screen.

[Level 360 Advancement has been activated!]

[You have reached the prerequisite for Advancement: 3/3]

[You have activated Apotheosis Advancement!]

[A new Advancement can be unlocked!]

Due to the Apotheosis Advancement, Basic END bonus has increased from + 160 to + 480! Currently, 1 END = 1,170 Health = 1,180 Stamina.

Your (God's Trait Transformation — Machinery) has reached the maximum level. You have received an additional life level evolution!

Your race has been detected as [Black Star Race] (Exclusive Race, unable to be changed)

Detected that your evolution route (Void) has reached its peak and cannot be improved any further. You can continue to optimize your genes.

[Detected Apotheosis Advancement. Normal optimization canceled. Do you want to evolve your exclusive race?]

[… Evolution confirmed. [Black Star Race] has evolved into [Black Star God Race]. Your life level has been enhanced, and your genetic structure has been strengthened. You have received additional attributes: + 2,140 STR, + 1,705 DEX, + 2,600 END, + 3,440 INT, + 3,052 MYS, + 1,024 CHA, + 26200 Energy. Your Energy Level bonus attributes have changed!]

[Your Black Star God Race Talent [Mechanical Genius] has been improved!]

[Mechanical Genius]: Total Machinery Affinity bonus increased from 1.55x to 1.65x. Machinery Creation Performance bonus increased from 70% to 80%. + 3 to + 4 for all Mechanic skills.

Your (God's Trait Transformation — Void) has reached the maximum level. You have received an additional life level evolution!

Detected race: [Black Star God Race] (Exclusive Race, cannot be changed)

Detected that your evolution route (Void) has reached its peak and cannot be improved any further. You can continue to optimize your genes.

Detected Apotheosis Advancement. Normal optimization canceled. Do you want to evolve your exclusive race?]

[… Evolution confirmed. [Black Star God Race] has evolved into [Black Star God Race — Royal Bloodline]. Your life level has been enhanced, and your genetic structure has been strengthened. You have received additional attributes: + 2,780 STR, + 2,410 DEX, + 3,250 END, + 4,216 INT, + 3,710 MYS, + 1,987 CHA, + 32800 Energy Level bonus attributes have changed!

Your Black Star Protoss Talent [Mechanical Genius] has been improved.

[Mechanical Genius]: Total Machinery Affinity bonus increased from 1.65x to 1.75x, Machinery Creation bonus increased from 80% to 90%, All Mechanic Class Skill Levels + 4 to + 5

Originally, there was no Species Evolution Opportunity at Level 360. However, with two God's Trait Transformations at max level, there were two additional Life Evolution Opportunities.

Rumble!

With Han Xiao as the center, the surging energy was so dense that it could almost condense into a solid substance. With Han Xiao as the center, it recklessly gushed out in all directions and spread far and wide. It had already been raised to the level of a cosmic energy surge. Almost all of the Black Star Corps' outposts in this area rang with alarms.

Blazing energy flowed through his body, and all the cells in his body rapidly ascended to a higher level of life. It was as if they had their own independent consciousness, but under the support of the Ethereal Nation Weapon, they did not disperse, and their bodies did not undergo any major changes.

An endless stream of energy surged in from all directions. Han Xiao had almost turned into the core of a nebula. His entire body was filled with blazing waves, and he felt as if he had become a balloon. His body felt like it was going to burst from the inside out.

He tried his best to maintain the operation of his mind and stared at the notifications on the interface.

This wave of enhancement was extremely powerful. If not for the Race Evolution brought about by the Apotheosis Promotion, the simple genetic optimization of a normal Promotion would not have been able to bring about such a high increase in attributes.

However, the notifications of these two Race Evolutions were not over yet.

Your Race Exclusive has been upgraded to [Black Star Protoss]. You have received a new talent [Mechanical Divine Body]!

[Divine Mechanical Body]: + 1,500% Machinery Affinity. Your Mechanical Force has been strengthened. Your [Emperor's Gift] has been upgraded to [God's Gift], your [Apostle Life Creation] has been upgraded to [God's Gift], your [Apostle Life Creation] has been upgraded to [God's Messenger Life Creation], your [Tinder Awakening] has been upgraded to [Source of Tinder], and your [Dimension Factory] has been upgraded to [Godly Fortress].

Your Race Exclusive has been upgraded to [Black Star Protoss — Royal Bloodline]. You have received a new talent [Void Divine Body]!

Han Xiao controlled his eyeballs with difficulty and looked at the introductions of these two talents.

The four Mechanic skills had undergone a special evolution. Among them, [God's Gift] and [God's Messenger Creation] had been strengthened in terms of basic values. Their specific functions had not changed, and only the name of the Apostle Weapon had changed to Mechanical Oracle.

[Source of Tinder] and [Godly Fortress] had functional changes.

[Tinder Awakening] was an ability used to create Mechanical Lifeforms. It needed to be cast, but after the evolution, there was an additional passive effect. As long as a machine was connected by Mechanical Force, it could temporarily become a Mechanical Lifeform and receive the various enhancements of a Mechanical Lifeform. If the Mechanical Force was disconnected, the effect would disappear. However, if used for a long time, the effect would be solidified and the Mechanical Lifeform would be permanently turned into a Mechanical Lifeform. This way, the efficiency and scale of creating Mechanical Lifeforms would be raised to a whole new level, and the consumption would be lower.

Furthermore, the function of [Godly Fortress] was to open a secondary dimension in his body as a Dimension Factory. There was no need to summon a secondary dimension gate anymore. It was like the advanced version of the Mechanical Body. There were no side effects, and even if the external environment was locked down by the Space Stabilization Anchor, it could still be used as a Dimension Factory.

[Void Body] had a similar effect. It could open up a new Void Dimension in one's body and even devour the original Void Dimension to perfect one's own Void Dimension.

The mechanism revealed by these two talents was like forming a universe in his body!

"Is this the difference between the new grades?"

Han Xiao was shocked.

Even at this point, the evolution was still not over. The notifications were still popping up, and intense pain assaulted his mind.

The power released by the burning of the Beyonder's Vestige was washing his cells over and over again, causing them to change time and time again. They gradually approached the special 'perfect' particle form, and the changes in his body became more and more intense. Sometimes big, sometimes small, sometimes expanding, and sometimes contracting.

At the same time, the four young men who were continuously supplying energy finally realized that something was wrong.

From Han Xiao's body, an aura that made them tremble from the depths of their souls was emitted. It was as if they had seen an existence one level higher in the food chain.

"Am I seeing things? Is this the pressure of a life rating?!"

Kasuyi's eyes widened in shock.

"It can't be wrong. It's this feeling …"

Milizaus' dragon beard fluttered, and disbelief flashed across his huge dragon eyes. He secretly swallowed a mouthful of dragon breath.

Wuornos, who was originally quite calm, could not remain calm anymore. His face was filled with shock as he stared at Han Xiao's figure, who was shooting out endless light, in shock.

'Oh my god, this guy can't be a blind cat running into a dead mouse and really succeed in one go, right?!'
